description: Selected-account scoped userdata settings from cPanel 11.32. Both pinned GET variants declare non-read-only behavior and use form POST under repository policy. Preserve raw scalar inputs and dynamic private string-map results; offline coverage only, with live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.74 open.

notes.text: Available from cPanel 11.32 with no pinned role or plugin restriction. Both formal source variants are GET and declare x-readonly=false and x-rollback=none. These annotations do not establish a hidden side effect, live POST acceptance or immutability.

The getter prose says it returns all userdata key/value pairs for the given scope, while the formal source classifies it as non-read-only. Preserve that distinction without guessing a hidden side effect or claiming live immutability.

Use one form POST under repository policy for non-read-only operations and private input fields. scope, json, key and value remain exact scalar strings encoded once; the json field is not an application/json request body. No local JSON parsing, reserialization, format validation or normalization occurs.

Returns a required nonnullable dynamic map of string values, preserving arbitrary keys and values including empty strings and zero-like strings. Missing data, explicit null, nonempty list roots and nonstring entries fail. Existing empty-array map compatibility and PHP numeric-string object-key conversion remain unchanged; decoding distinguishes objects from arrays.

Scope names, keys, values, raw results, responseMeta() and PayloadMismatchException::$payload can expose private account settings. All input parameters are sensitive as privacy policy, without assuming they are authentication tokens. Library-owned exception frames conceal inputs and response/error arguments; third-party transports control their own traces. Deliberate payload and metadata inspection remains caller responsibility.

The client adds no implicit read, merge, key deletion, readback, retry, rollback, cache of server settings, returned-path access or URL fetch. Offline fixtures establish no live acceptance or server settings behavior; live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.74 remains open.
